messages.content: Propose four finite numeric coefficients, each between -2 and 2, for prioritizing walls in an exact grid path planner. The score is a linear weighted sum of these features, in order: (1) start-goal straight segment intersects wall (0 or 1), (2) wall length divided by map diagonal, (3) min(distance(start,wall endpoint)+distance(endpoint,goal)) divided by map diagonal, (4) any wall endpoint touches map boundary (0 or 1). The highest scoring k walls are initially activated, where k is the number intersecting the start-goal segment. After exact relaxed search, all walls are checked and collision walls are added; after 3 failures all walls are enabled. Aim to reduce total preparation, repeated search and validation cost. Maps have horizontal and vertical closed line-segment barriers and 8-neighbor movement. No evaluation-map outcomes are available. This is proposal 1 of 12. Return only a JSON array of exactly four coefficients. Do not output code.
